svg.text: RFC Lifecycle: Evidence to Production Learning
Standing mandates define the boundary; risk sets the gates; production evidence closes the loop.
Leadership defines direction, scope, budget, permissions, constraints, and expiry.
observe / propose / benchmark / modify in scope / canary 10% / auto-rollback
change mandate / expand scope / raise budget or risk ceiling / grant itself access
Observed fact, never a proposed solution
metrics / logs / tickets / incidents / code refs
Dedupe / cluster / link goals + existing RFCs
EV ranks; WIP + budget constrain entry
confidence threshold; sponsor; task or runbook?
task / mini-RFC / full RFC / duplicate / discard
rollout / rollback / budget / risk / observe / handoff
cheap: search / tests / routine code / benchmark
claim evidence is updated, not merely asserted
auto-rollback; R0-R1 in mandate; R2+ gated
success / guardrails / cost / incidents / user impact
PRODUCTION EVIDENCE -> NEW SIGNAL / AMENDMENT / NEXT CANDIDATE
Versioned Context Pack -> Claim Graph -> Decision Record -> Execution Plan -> Observation Report
Years later, the system can reconstruct what was known, assumed, decided, delegated, and observed.
The RFC author cannot self-select a lower tier.
agent may merge; notify or sample audit
policy ceiling, human delegation, trust profile,
confidence never expands authority by itself
A blocker cites invariant, evidence, failure scenario,
Accepted residual risk is explicit and recorded.
